argv: set -eu; live=/etc/caddy/Caddyfile; target=$(readlink -f "$live"); case "$target" in /etc/caddy/orbit-versions/*/Caddyfile) ;; *) echo "live Caddyfile is not the product-managed symlink: $target" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; test -L "$live"; test ! -e /etc/caddy/Caddyfile.orbit-e2e; fragment=$(dirname "$target")/fragments/00-orbit-e2e-global.caddy; grep -q local_certs "$fragment"; test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a "$fragment")" = root:caddy:640; caddy validate --config "$live" --adapter caddyfile >/dev/null 2>&1; code=$(curl --silent --show-error --retry 10 --retry-delay 2 --retry-all-errors --max-time 20 --cacert "$(cat /var/lib/orbit-e2e/caddy-ca-path)" --resolve laravel.internal:443:127.0.0.1 https://laravel.internal/ -o /dev/null -w %{http_code}); test "$code" = 200; echo "app-prod serves https://laravel.internal (HTTP $code) from the managed version $target with fragment $fragment"
